description: Add an alias (domain, wallet, erc8004, platform) so the entity reaches L1: the registry verifies the proof, then your document lists the alias, re-signed with your key (used for this call only). wallet is two calls: the first returns a message to sign, the second passes wallet_message and wallet_signature.

value.description: domain: example.com. wallet: 0x address. erc8004: eip155:<chain>:<registry>:<agentId>. platform: <platform>:<handle>

wallet_message.description: wallet step 2: the message from step 1

wallet_signature.description: wallet step 2: EIP-191 personal_sign of wallet_message, 0x hex

name: openentity_alias_add
